hookSpecificOutput.permissionDecisionReason: Containment breach blocked (ENF-07): `origin` resolves to the UPSTREAM open-gsd/gsd-core. Pushing private work to upstream from branch `next` leaks it. If this is a deliberate, accountable maintainer push to `origin`, set GSD_CONTRIB_OVERRIDE="<reason>" and re-run — the push is then ALLOWED and a per-worktree override receipt is logged. Otherwise push to a fork (`git push fork next`) and open a PR, or use your `!` shell channel.
